scope: All 228 physical E01 lines are indexed to exactly one manually reviewed evidence beat. These are beat-level interpretations, not unique deep commentary for every individual line. Do not call the story-wide analysis complete.

age_disclaimer.exact_phrase: All sexually involved characters are 18 years and above.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: E01 title, Dhika age 29, John as husband, college Physics teaching, child and all-sexually-involved-characters-18+ disclaimer.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Author establishes voice, domestic/social context, and age condition before scenes.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: The opening establishes Uncle's attraction and his decision not to disclose it to Dhika, John or Aunty.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Narrator grants reader access to knowledge withheld from Dhika.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Dhika leaves Pappu in Uncle's care, explains milk and departs for college.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Ordinary caretaking creates later apartment access.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Bantu compliments Dhika at college; she blushes, shushes him, and checks if anyone overheard.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Recurring public compliment plus embarrassment plus exceptional familiarity.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Bobby is quieter; Bantu leads conversation. Dhika has a special soft spot for Bobby, while anticipating Bantu's compliments.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: The narrative separates initiative from affective preference.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Narrator describes Dhika's conservative attire and her deliberate restraint around others.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Narrated modesty defines baseline; clothing choices should not automatically imply consent.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Sharmi pinches Dhika's waist, greets her and is established as childhood best friend and co-worker.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Playful friendship touch, fast banter, sartorial contrast.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Sharmi's playful envy, Raj's compliment, and mutual banter establish Dhika/Sharmi comparison.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Sharmi and Raj are mentioned, not given an intimate encounter with Dhika.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Uncle privately handles an intimate garment belonging to Dhika, conceals the action when Aunty calls, and leaves it behind.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Secret violation versus Dhika's trust; no bodily contact with Dhika.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Bantu initiates after-class compliments while Bobby watches. Dhika is flattered and the narration calls Bantu 18.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Distinct dialogue activity; check E01 L77 for stated age.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Bobby notices a small area of Dhika's hip; Dhika recognizes what he is seeing and chooses not to make a scene.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Actual visual observation, not touching or an imagined view.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Bantu claims his scooter lacks petrol; narration confirms the scooter is functional and he seeks a ride with Dhika.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Narrator separates his stated reason from private intention.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Bantu and Bobby notice Dhika while walking; Bobby quickly takes the seat immediately behind her, contrary to Bantu's wish.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Physical proximity acquired by seat choice; Bantu disappointed.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Bobby holds Dhika at waist/stomach, his finger taps over the saree, and her hip is contacted. Dhika is startled, shy, and silent.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Actual contact; Dhika's interpretation of Bobby's innocence is not independent evidence of his intention.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Ride ends; Bantu is dissatisfied and Bobby privately knows details Bantu does not.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Knowledge asymmetry between brothers is a continuity constraint.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Aunty returns Pappu; Dhika hears about his feeding and moves into her home routine while John remains at work.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Separates childcare from adult attraction threads.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Dhika finds her garment unexpectedly displaced, but assumes it fell without suspecting Uncle.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Reader knows E01 L64–69; Dhika does not.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Bindu Maami's shop and delivery worker Babu/Chotu are introduced: Chotu is 19, financially supports his family, and has been welcomed into Dhika's home.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Pre-existing kindness and access, not a sudden stranger introduction.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Dhika puts on her shawl, receives Chotu, uses the nickname 'Chotu Babu', and asks him to bring a missing packet.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Affectionate naming, repeat errands, ordinary rapport.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Dhika's shawl is occupied by Pappu's play; she opens the door expecting Chotu simply to collect money.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: A small domestic obstacle creates accidental vulnerability.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Chotu enters to greet Pappu, follows Dhika to request water, and Dhika insists he stay briefly for juice.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: A short planned exchange becomes a longer visit.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: While serving Chotu, Dhika realizes the absence of her shawl; his stunned reaction follows, but the precise content of his first view remains ambiguous to Dhika.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Actual visible posture and reaction; Dhika's questions about what he saw are uncertainty, not verified visual facts.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Chotu leaves without payment, Maami says he went home, and Dhika ultimately attributes his odd reaction to family worries.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Dhika misreads his behavior; preserve source knowledge gap.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: John calls about an office production issue and will not return that night; Dhika carries on family routine.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Work constraint creates solitude; not marital abandonment.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Dhika privately revisits the shawl incident, moves from self-reproach toward curiosity, then redirects herself and sleeps.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Private thought should not be counted as a new physical encounter.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Saturday family routines continue; Dhika remembers money owed and contacts Maami for Chotu's visit.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: A practical errand bridges days.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Chotu returns. Dhika offers him lunch, noting John is at work. Chotu initially wants to go home but agrees.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Hospitality and repeated proximity arise from longstanding trust.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Chotu resists dining at the table; Dhika chooses to sit with him on the floor. They discuss food and family.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Dhika accommodates class/status discomfort and gains emotional trust.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Chotu notices her sleeveless dress and compliments her. Dhika admits she wears it only at home and says she trusts him.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: He explicitly begins seeing her as attractive; Dhika sees the compliment as meaningful.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Dhika reflects in the mirror on her appearance and whether she is still seen as beautiful after motherhood.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Self-image motif: curiosity changes from what a man sees to how she sees herself.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Dhika consciously chooses not to use the shawl and returns intending to learn from Chotu's response.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Deliberate presentation is distinct from E01 L128–151's accidental circumstances.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Chotu notices Dhika's changed clothing situation; she bends down while cleaning and he responds with visible surprise.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: Actual observation. Avoid treating his unsaid intention as established beyond narrated reactions.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Dhika meets Chotu's eyes; he departs abruptly. She remains embarrassed, curious and excited in private.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: A visual encounter and psychological shift, not a kiss or bodily contact.

evidence_beats.source_grounded_finding: Closing whitespace and delimiter; no further scene.
evidence_beats.writing_mechanism: No additional plot event.

john.e01: Marital relationship; office emergency and overnight absence are shown.

chotu.e01: Grocery deliveries, lunch, compliments, deliberate visual interaction; no kiss and no direct intimate body touch with Dhika in E01.
chotu.unknown: Do not confuse thoughts with observed action.

bantu.e01: Compliments and planned scooter ride; brother occupies closest seat.
bantu.unknown: Bantu does not know Bobby's full ride experience.

bobby.e01: Closest scooter seat and actual contact at Dhika's waist/stomach/hip; his observations are distinct from Bantu's.
bobby.unknown: Do not infer more contact than documented.

uncle.e01: Privately handles intimate garment; Dhika suspects only accidental displacement.
uncle.unknown: No partnered physical encounter with Dhika.

sharmi.e01: Playful waist pinch, teasing, visual contrast.
sharmi.unknown: No later relationship change proven here.

raj.unknown: No direct scene with Dhika in E01.

leo.unknown: Do not back-project E05 into E01

unresolved_at_e01: Dhika has not identified Uncle as responsible for the displaced garment.
Bantu does not know the details of Bobby's scooter contact.
Dhika is not sure what Chotu saw in the earlier accidental incident.
John's work absences provide context, not proof of marital breakdown.
Dhika's increasingly deliberate self-presentation to Chotu is developing without a kiss as of E01.
